edits.value_json: An oracle-bone example 小雨 is reported with 小 meaning “small.” This is a documented early use, not proof of the character’s hypothetical original referent.
小 means “small.” An oracle-bone example uses it with this meaning; the early marks have been interpreted either as abstract signs of smallness or as fine sand grains.
